# claude.md - Basic Receptionist (STREAMLINED) (tree 862603108)

## Purpose
Front-desk law-firm call handler, rebuilt as a LINEAR top-to-bottom flow. One intake screen -> classify script -> one conditional-field details screen -> gather script -> optional Calendly -> summary -> end. Replaces the branchy 30-node version.

## Architecture (linear spine; only 3 branches)
- 1 Content (ROOT) Greet + capture: name/phone/mail, caller_type, conditional case_number (existing), returning_kind (returning), other_type (other), hidden law_firm. -> 2
- 2 Script Classify caller: sets go_subtree; stages screen_html guidance. -> 3
- 3 Router New client/new matter? go_subtree==true -> 4 (subtree); else -> 5
- 4 Tree Full intake in Main Intake (142849578@1), terminal hand-off (return 0)
- 5 Content Caller reason and details: renders ${transforms.screen_html}; ONE screen of native conditional fields keyed on caller_type + call_reason (schedule/forms/cancel/contact/courtroom/complaint/billing/prospect; returning past-case; other-caller). Replaces old reason menu + per-reason screens + courtroom/billing/other/not-a-client nodes. -> 6
- 6 Script Gather details, set should_schedule. -> 7
- 7 Router Schedule a consultation? should_schedule==true -> 8; else -> 13
- 8 Data Pull Calendly times (Connected Object 'calendly'). -> 9
- 9 Script Map slots -> calendly_slots + calendly_has_slots + calendly_notice_html. -> 10
- 10 Router Any times? calendly_has_slots==true -> 11; else -> 12
- 11 Content Book time (native dynamic select from calendly_slots). -> 13
- 12 Content No times - capture preferred day/time. -> 13
- 13 Script Build call summary (summary_html/text). -> 14
- 14 Content End call + copy-to-clipboard summary (TERMINAL)
- 15 Content claude.md (UNLINKED memory node)

## Data dictionary
Form vars: name, phone, mail, law_firm(hidden), caller_type, case_number, returning_kind, other_type, call_reason, deadline, reason_notes, forms_wants_consult, cancel_reschedule, cancel_notes, new_phone, new_email, new_address, attorney_reachable, complaint_notes, billing_issue, billing_notes, prospect_action, past_case_number, past_case_wants_schedule, company, acquaintance_action, other_notes, selected_time. Script-set booleans: go_subtree (router 3), should_schedule (router 7), calendly_has_slots (router 10). Transforms: screen_html (node2->5), calendly_slots/calendly_notice_html (node9->11/12), summary_html/summary_text (node13->14).

## Conventions & gotchas
- LINEAR by design: only 3 routers, for genuinely divergent processes (subtree, scheduling, Calendly availability). Everything else is one conditional-field screen driven by a script.
- Native conditional fields (config.conditional.simple) show only the inputs needed; required enforced only while a field is visible.
- Routers test only script-set booleans. merge_vars_not_fixed='1' (shared screens render staged ${transforms.*}).
- law_firm is a hidden field placeholder ('[Your Law Firm Name]') - edit per firm.
- Calendly Data node (8) still needs the real 'calendly' Connected Object wired; node 9 degrades to the no-times path if empty.

## Changelog
- 2026-07-21 - Brent via Claude (streamlined rebuild) - collapsed the 30-node branchy tree to a 15-node linear spine per the 'linear top-to-bottom, minimize branching' rule. Reason menu, courtroom, billing, complaint, contact-change, other-caller, past-case and not-a-client/prospect screens folded into ONE conditional-field screen (node 5) fed by a classify script (2) and read by a gather script (6). Kept 3 branches only. Delivered as 'Basic Receptionist (Streamlined).json' alongside the Improved version.
- 2026-07-21 - Brent via Claude (titles + no-blank-router-evals) - gave every node a descriptive node_name (internal, with the why) and page_title. Fixed routers 3/7/10: replaced the blank else buttons with explicit complementary expressions (go_subtree/should_schedule/calendly_has_slots == false); continuation_node_id kept as the structural fallback. Per the new 'no blank router evaluations' rule.
